title: GTA Online
headline: GTA Online
subtitle: Take Down the Kortz Center and More High-Value Targets in This Week’s Heist Event
content:
Assemble a crew of familiar faces or perfect strangers, gather your gear, execute a robbery, and exfiltrate safely to earn doubled first-time completion bonuses for completing all the Original Heists, The Doomsday Heist, and The Diamond Casino Heist.

To commemorate The Kortz Center Heist’s inaugural Heist Event, you and your accomplices are guaranteed to find The Outcome of Endeavour — previously only available to those who reached Elitist status in this summer’s Fine Art Collector program.
